verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app builder that handles user prompts and project data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-usage controls. The security-and-data page cited only mentions downloading SQL dumps, which is data export, not training prevention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
